label: fictional-austin-showcase
note: SYNTHETIC. One fictional Austin-shaped office for the Friday showcase (scripts/seed-austin-demo.mjs, scripts/qa-austin-showcase.mjs). Every name, address, email, reference and amount is invented. Dates are day offsets before the run day in the office time zone. Tenant references match the fixed tenancies of server/testing/fictional-rei-portal.ts so the fictional REI portal can match the bank rows. Adapted from scripts/testing/austin-day-one-seed.json on branch claude/austin-day-one-rehearsal.

mailbox.note: Thread and message ids are hex because the mail routes accept only hex ids. Triage mail avoids bill words so W2 picks up only the bill threads.
